description: Adds tiers/modifiers for tools/armors and even more! Inspired from TieredZ's Globox

mods.name: Hero's Tiered
mods.description: Adds tiers/modifiers for tools/armors. Port and inspired from TieredZ's Globox

releases.notes:
## Added:
- Projectiles now can do critical hits
  - Bows when fully charged and doing a vanilla critical (trail) can also crit. Doing even further damage.
- Added clamp durability bar, preventing overflow negative values and better dynamic for the changes of durability itself for tiered items.
- Added NeoForge merged attribute tooltips.
- Added TieredNeoAPI for external mods.
## Fixed:
- Fixed multipliers (X%+) not applying.
- Fixed a technical server-side bypass on reforge menu (Globox's fix)
- Fixed an exploit to preview a tier.
- Fixed bad weight distribution when negative values.
- Fixed duplicate attribute sections.
- Fixed an issue where prefixes would cumulatively stack with each `/reload` on renaming items.
## Changed:
- Reforge menu now uses `#minecraft:anvil`, supporting modded anvils.
- The style of the tiers names remains constant even after they are renamed.
- Updated dependencies.
- Code cleaning.

releases.notes:
## Added:
- HerosLib dependency added
- Hero's Levels compat added
- Easy Anvils compat added
- Added spanish translation
## Fixed:
- Fixed ([#1](https://github.com/Herobrot/tieredneo/issues/1)) about the loot on chest not adding the tiers/modifiers
## Changed:
- Rework of the code. From the player's perspective, there shouldn't be any noticeable difference, other than better performance (I hope).
  - Deleted the implementation about tabs and now using the HerosLib feature with tabs.
- Now the luck (and the smithing level if Hero's Levels is present) is additive, reducing the bigger weight (Common)
  - Expect having more Epic and Legendary modifier. But Unique is still very rare.
